Audits one checkpoint, its Hydra config, nine latency settings and three seeds, and explicitly leaves source licensing unresolved; no inference ran.
The 20-row register contains no LaCo-SENet entry, so no local asset identity is available.
Marks laco-senet as blocked, disposition sdk-model and verification_profile enhancement; it is not a result.

peer_evidence.boundary: FastEnhancer Small is a separate offline CPU comparator; its local DNS metrics, runtime and assets do not establish LaCo-SENet streaming quality or latency.
DTLN uses a different 16 kHz streaming state, frame schedule and 384-sample lag; none of it is LaCo-SENet evidence.
Base GTCRN streaming ONNX has its own lookahead and state contract; it is not the LaCo-SENet lookahead curve.
ConvFSENet is a separate causal enhancer with its own checkpoint, quantization and geometry blockers.
